snippet.title: Survivalist: Invisible Strain Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Survivalist: Invisible Strain launch trailer, showing gameplay and story.  Out on the 25th of April on XBox Series X|S, and leaving Early Access on Steam on the same date.
https://www.xbox.com/en-GB/games/store/survivalist-invisible-strain/9nbc4xfk06l9
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1054510/Survivalist_Invisible_Strain/

The music in the trailer is a track called Missing You by Roald Strauss from indiegamemusic.com, which also featured in the original Survivalist game.
https://www.indiegamemusic.com/viewtrack.php?id=57
